## Biography

A boundary. Nothing more.

The Praei-two plane marks the edge of permit-locked space — a mathematical surface beyond which civilian navigation systems refuse to plot courses. Commander LilacLight found the derelict prototype drifting toward this boundary, "lazy vector, no power, no transponder." The DW3 expedition was not authorised to cross. They observed from the legal side, scanning passively, sending boarding parties to a hull that should not exist in territory that should be empty.

Boundaries exist for reasons. Sometimes the reasons are political. Sometimes they are older than politics. The Praei-two plane is where the known galaxy ends and something else begins. What that something is, the DW3 expedition only glimpsed — through portholes, through scanner readouts, through the nanite residue that consumed a crew and left no survivors to explain why.
